name: Transmit
placementTarget: Back of each player reference card, with the Build Satellite Tower strip.
text:
TRANSMIT
At a satellite tower, give a card matching the color of your city to another player,
anywhere in the world.

[satellite dish inside signal rings]

mechanics.timing: Action, on your turn, in a city with a satellite tower.
mechanics.effect: Give a card matching the color of your city to another player, anywhere in the world.
restrictions: This strip is the short action reminder. Rule O is stricter: you must be in a city containing a satellite tower, and you give 1 card matching the color of the city you are in.
The other player may be anywhere in the world.
